_comment: Real-head reranker, v3.3 BLEND recipe. Identical to sweep_config_reranker_real_v32.json EXCEPT combine_mode=blend and out_root. Same real-head retriever (v31_baseline), same real corpus, same task=[2], same seeds/epochs/topc/lr/temperature/arch -> a fair A/B of recipe on real data, mirroring the synthetic v3.2-vs-v3.3 methodology. reranker_router consumes this + the real_v32 results to make the per-recipe deployed choice (do-no-harm validation-gated). No WS3 real bar (ws3_results path intentionally absent); what matters is deployed ndcg@10 vs the real-head retriever 0.558 and the oracle ceiling.
